cohort: The study included 1,316 parturients diagnosed with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP) between 2018 and 2023.
finding: A longer duration of labor epidural analgesia (LEA) was associated with a reduced risk of early-onset postpartum hypertension (PPHTN) among women with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP).
followup_time: 2 days postpartum (primary outcome), up to 5 days postpartum (sensitivity analysis)
